📅 2025-09-16 Unidentified / Unspecified — Unspecified — N/A / No status INC-097
Attacked causing significant damage to rooftop water tanks, electrical and communication systems and some medical equipment.

According to the director-general of the World Health Organization Tedros Abhanom Ghebreyesus "Al-Rantisi Hospital in #Gaza City was attacked yesterday while 80 patients were inside. No casualties were reported but the strikes caused panic among patients and staff. Significant damage to rooftop water tanks, electrical and communication systems, and some medical equipment were reported. 40 patients fled for safety, while 40 others, including 4 children in the intensive care and 8 newborns, remain inside."

📅 2023-11-10 Unidentified / Unspecified — Unspecified — Forced evacuation INC-232
The Rantisi Specialised Hospital for Children and the nearby Al-Nasr hospital, in the north of Gaza City, were evacuated on Friday,

The IDF released to the BBC details of phone conversations between an official at Rantisi and a senior officer in the IDF, in which they discussed arrangements to get ambulances to evacuate patients. The hospital official asked about hundreds of displaced civilians camped out at the two hospitals. The Israeli officer told them to leave via the main entrance at 11:20 and explained in detail which streets they should walk along to leave Gaza City. And he twice told the hospital official to make sure civilians were carrying something white to show they were not combatants. "They will all go out with their hands in the air," the hospital official said. "Perfect," the Israeli said.

📅 2023-11-09 Generic Strike / Attack — Direct hit — Ceased/out of service INC-322
The hospital was evacuated and bombed.

On 9 November 2023 the IDF ordered al-Rantisi Hospital to evacuate, claiming there was Hamas infrastructure in the facility. Tanks were seen in the vicinity of the hospital and the hospital director said that the facility was bombed twice, killing at least one child. Many children could not be evacuated because they were unable to walk and actively receiving care such as dialysis and chemo. The bombings resulted in large fires in the hospital causing damage. The hospital ran out of fuel rendering it out of service and leaving 38 children with kidney failure without access to dialysis treatment.

1 killed
Sources: 🔗 nbcnews 🔗 aa 🔗 palestinercs ⌛ archiving pending 🔗 aa 🔗 apnews
View full incident →
📅 2023-11-06 – 2023-11-07 Unidentified / Unspecified — Unspecified — Evacuated/Evacuation order INC-338
Israel issued an evacuation order for al-Rantisi hospital.

On 6 November, Israel ordered al-Rantisi Hospital to evacuate, claiming facility was being used by Hamas. For the second consecutive day, on 7 November, the Israeli military ordered the evacuation of the Rantisi hospital in Gaza city, claiming that armed groups were using its premises and surroundings. This hospital is the only pediatric facility in northern Gaza, and it also accommodates about 6,000 IDPs. According to the MoH in Gaza, its evacuation would jeopardize the lives of 15 children on life support, 38 children undergoing kidney dialysis, 10 children relying on artificial respiratory devices, and others who are injured.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt 🔗 ochaopt
View full incident →
📅 2023-11-05 18:30 Generic Strike / Attack — Direct hit — N/A / No status INC-337
Rantisi Hospital was damaged by a strike in the area.

Rantisi Hospital was struck directly and indirectly causing damage to the facility, killing four people, and injuring 35 people. The water tanks and solar panels were hit, cutting off running water. At the time of the attack there were about 5,000 people on hospital grounds including patients, staff, and displaced families sheltering there.

4 killed35 injured
